name.ja: バンド計算の対称群・既約表現
name.en: Band symmetry groups and irreducible representations

summary.ja: 空間群、小群、非共型対称性、SOCの二重群、時間反転とKramers縮退を区別する。
summary.en: Distinguish space/little groups, nonsymmorphic symmetry, SOC double groups, time reversal and Kramers pairing.

references.label: Aroyo, M. I.; Kirov, A.; Capillas, C.; Perez-Mato, J. M.; Wondratschek, H. (2006), Bilbao Crystallographic Server. II. Representations of crystallographic point groups and space groups
references.scope: Primary source for band-symmetry concepts and conventions. Introductory review; no atlas band-structure calculation or irrep assignment has been numerically reproduced.

references.label: Hinuma, Y.; Pizzi, G.; Kumagai, Y.; Oba, F.; Tanaka, I. (2017), Band structure diagram paths based on crystallography
references.scope: Primary source for band-symmetry concepts and conventions. Introductory review; no atlas band-structure calculation or irrep assignment has been numerically reproduced.

assumptions: Introductory formulation and comparison, not a verified executable solver.
Representative electronic-structure formulas use nonrelativistic Born–Oppenheimer theory unless the section explicitly states otherwise.
units: Atomic units in the displayed electronic equations (hbar = m_e = e = 4 pi epsilon_0 = 1); dimensionless conventions are stated where needed.
boundary_conditions: Isolated or periodic conditions must be selected for each physical system; no numerical boundary-value example is published here yet.

next_deliverable.ja: 解説・一次文献と既存の小規模例との対応を保守する。専用実装の追加は必要性が指定された場合に小さな教育用例から検討し、重い収束走査・独立参照の再生成・長時間MDは通常の作業へ含めない。
next_deliverable.en: Maintain the reading, primary sources and links to existing small examples. Consider a dedicated implementation only when needed, starting with a small educational case; routine work excludes heavy convergence sweeps, reference regeneration and long MD.

limitations.ja: 群の概念・代表式・一次文献を公開。専用の実装と実計算の既約表現の割当てはUnder construction。ここで提供するのは群の概念・条件・計算での使い方の導入です。全空間群の指標表や、実計算の波動関数への既約表現の自動割当て、対称性によるトポロジー判定は未実装です。
limitations.en: Introductory group concepts, representative equations and primary sources are available. No dedicated implementation or verified band-irrep assignment is provided yet. This is an introduction to concepts, conditions and their computational use. Complete character tables, automatic irrep assignment to computed wavefunctions and symmetry-based topology classification are not implemented.

metadata_review.level: curated introductory formulation with primary publication and official-documentation entry points; full derivation audit and numerical examples pending

assumptions_ja: 定式化と比較の導入解説であり、実行・検証済みソルバーではありません。
代表式は、各節に別記する場合を除き非相対論・Born–Oppenheimerの電子状態問題を想定します。
units_ja: 表示する電子状態の式は原子単位系（ℏ = m_e = e = 4πε₀ = 1）。無次元量や占有の規約は各節に明記。
boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立・周期を対象系ごとに選ぶ必要があります。この導入には実行済みの境界値計算例はまだありません。

caution.ja: ここで提供するのは群の概念・条件・計算での使い方の導入です。全空間群の指標表や、実計算の波動関数への既約表現の自動割当て、対称性によるトポロジー判定は未実装です。
caution.en: This is an introduction to concepts, conditions and their computational use. Complete character tables, automatic irrep assignment to computed wavefunctions and symmetry-based topology classification are not implemented.
